title: Every Sₙ and Aₙ Realized as a Galois Group — the Generic Function-Field Construction
description: Realizes, with 0 sorries and 0 axioms, *every* symmetric group Sₙ and alternating group Aₙ simultaneously as the Galois group of a field extension, via the classical generic construction. The symmetric group `Sₙ = Equiv.Perm (Fin n)` acts faithfully on the rational function field `F = ℚ(x₁,…,xₙ) = FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℚ)` by permuting the variables, and Artin's fixed-field theorem then produces an explicit group isomorphism `realizeSn : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) ≃* (F ≃ₐ[F^{Sₙ}] F)` together with `IsGalois F^{Sₙ} F` and the degree `finrank_Sn : [F : F^{Sₙ}] = n!`. Restricting the same action to the alternating subgroup gives the parallel `realizeAn`, `isGalois_An`, and `finrank_An : [F : F^{Aₙ}] = |Aₙ|`. This is the Sₙ/Aₙ case of the (regular) inverse Galois problem: these two families need none of the Belyi/Thompson-rigidity machinery cited for the general RIGP — the elementary generic-polynomial route suffices and is Mathlib-reachable. The only construction built here is the concrete permutation action on the fraction field: rather than assemble it by hand, the proof routes the bundled monoid hom `IsFractionRing.fieldEquivOfAlgEquivHom` through `MvPolynomial.renameEquiv`, so that the `map_one`/`map_mul` functoriality obligations fall straight out of `renameEquiv_refl`/`renameEquiv_trans`, and faithfulness reduces to injectivity of `renameEquiv` (which is determined by `rename e (X i) = X (e i)`). Complements the sibling entry `abel-ruffini-galois-extensions-oq-01`, which realizes the single group S₅ concretely over ℚ via `X⁵ − 4X + 2`; the present entry realizes all n at once over a transcendental base.

meta.author: Formalized in Lean 4 with Mathlib

mathlibDependencies.description: Artin's theorem in bundled form: for a finite group G acting faithfully on a field F, the group isomorphism `G ≃* (F ≃ₐ[FixedPoints.subfield G F] F)` realizing G as the Galois group of F over its fixed field.
For a finite group G acting faithfully on a field F, `[F : F^G] = |G|`; used to compute the extension degrees n! and |Aₙ|.
The Normal, Algebra.IsSeparable and FiniteDimensional instances on `FixedPoints.subfield G F`, which together yield `IsGalois (F^G) F`.

The bundled monoid hom `(B ≃ₐ[A] B) →* (L ≃ₐ[K] L)` lifting an algebra automorphism of a ring to its fraction field; used to transport the variable-permutation action from ℚ[x₁,…,xₙ] to ℚ(x₁,…,xₙ). Its injectivity supplies faithfulness.
The algebra automorphism of `MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℚ` induced by a permutation of the variables, with its functoriality lemmas — the source of the monoid-hom structure `Sₙ →* (P ≃ₐ[ℚ] P)`.
The tautological faithful `MulSemiringAction (F ≃ₐ[ℚ] F) F`, composed with the permutation hom via `MulSemiringAction.compHom` to give the Sₙ- and Aₙ-actions on F.
The variables `X : Fin n → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℚ` are injective; used to prove the permutation action is faithful.

references.title: Topics in Galois Theory
references.note: Research Notes in Mathematics. Ch. 1 gives the generic realization of Sₙ (and Aₙ) as Galois groups over a purely transcendental base, the classical route formalized here, and situates it within the regular inverse Galois problem.

references.authors: Malle, G. and Matzat, B. H.
references.title: Inverse Galois Theory
references.note: Springer Monographs in Mathematics. The symmetric and alternating groups are the base cases of RIGP; the general theory (rigidity, Belyi maps) is needed only for other groups.

mainTheorems.name: realizeSn
mainTheorems.description: The headline result: an explicit group isomorphism realizing Sₙ as the Galois group of ℚ(x₁,…,xₙ) over the symmetric-function field ℚ(e₁,…,eₙ). Obtained by instantiating Artin's `FixedPoints.toAlgAutMulEquiv` at the faithful variable-permutation action.

mainTheorems.name: finrank_Sn
mainTheorems.statement: Module.finrank (FixedPoints.subfield (Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) F) F = Nat.factorial n
mainTheorems.description: The generic Sₙ extension has degree n!, computed from `FixedPoints.finrank_eq_card` and `Fintype.card_perm`.

mainTheorems.name: realizeAn
mainTheorems.description: The alternating analogue: Aₙ realized as the Galois group of ℚ(x₁,…,xₙ) over its fixed field ℚ(e₁,…,eₙ)(√disc), via the same Artin machinery restricted to the alternating subgroup.

mainTheorems.name: finrank_An
mainTheorems.statement: Module.finrank (FixedPoints.subfield (alternatingGroup (Fin n)) F) F = Fintype.card (alternatingGroup (Fin n))
mainTheorems.description: The generic Aₙ extension has degree |Aₙ| (equal to n!/2 for n ≥ 2).

mainTheorems.name: permFaithful
mainTheorems.description: The variable-permutation action of Sₙ on ℚ(x₁,…,xₙ) is faithful — the one nontrivial input to Artin's theorem — proved by reducing to injectivity of `renameEquiv` on the generators `X i`.

meta.assumptions: None beyond Mathlib's foundational axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound). No `axiom` declarations, no `sorry`, no `native_decide`. The result formalized is the Galois-group realization (Sₙ, Aₙ ≅ Gal of the generic extension) together with the extension degrees; the additional 'regularity' assertion of RIGP — that ℚ is algebraically closed in the fixed field, so the realization is regular — is discussed but not separately formalized here.
